WITH date_range AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_dim WHERE d_date BETWEEN '2001-04-02' AND '2001-06-01'
),
filtered_item AS (
    SELECT i_item_sk, i_item_id FROM item WHERE i_current_price BETWEEN 0.99 AND 1.49
)
SELECT w_state, i_item_id,
       SUM(CASE WHEN d_date < (SELECT MIN(d_date) FROM date_range) THEN cs_sales_price - COALESCE(cr_refunded_cash, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS sales_before,
       SUM(CASE WHEN d_date >= (SELECT MIN(d_date) FROM date_range) THEN cs_sales_price - COALESCE(cr_refunded_cash, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS sales_after
FROM catalog_sales
LEFT OUTER JOIN catalog_returns ON cs_order_number = cr_order_number AND cs_item_sk = cr_item_sk
JOIN date_range ON cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
JOIN filtered_item ON i_item_sk = cs_item_sk
GROUP BY w_state, i_item_id
ORDER BY w_state, i_item_id
LIMIT 100
